snippet.title: Marvel’s Wolverine - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Experience an original take on Marvel legend Wolverine as he joins forces with mutants across the globe in a fight for survival. Standing against forces like Bolivar Trask, Omega Red, Deathstrike and more... Logan knows the world needs a hero; however, they’ll have to settle for Wolverine.

Marvel’s Wolverine launches September 15, 2026, on PlayStation 5 consoles. Pre-order and wishlist now on the PlayStation Store. 

For more information, visit https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/marvels-wolverine/
